description: Prices a trip for every featured insurer. A single-trip quote also lists yearly plans for the same region under annualPlans. Each plan has its insurer, price in S$ with GST, the date the price was checked, excess, key cover limits and a buy link. Prices come from the broker's stored price tables for Singapore. No answer is required: one not given uses the quote form's default, and the reply says so. This is information, not advice to buy any plan.

ages.description: The travellers' ages. Read and noted in the reply. The stored prices are by number of adults and children, not by age.

annual.description: "yes" for a plan that covers every trip in a year. Give region with it.

countries.description: Destination. Several values are separated by commas.

cruise.description: Going on a cruise. "no" when not given.

days.description: Trip length in days, counting the day of leaving and the day of return.

destination.description: Where the trip goes: a country name such as "Japan", or several separated by commas ("Japan, Korea").

leaving.description: Days from today until the trip starts. 30 when not given. Or give departDate and returnDate.

limit.description: The most plans to return, counted from the top of the order. 10 when not given. The reply says how many plans were found in all.

rankBy.description: The order of the plans. "price": lowest price first (the default). "value": highest published value score first. Neither is advice.
